confirmed_task:
On Xbox.com, find a game listed under the “Best sellers” section. Open its product page and report the game’s publisher, developer, and release date.

Stopping condition: Stop after opening the product page and recording the publisher, developer, and release date.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not buy or download anything.

items.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section and select a listed game
items.description: Use Xbox.com (starting from https://www.xbox.com/ is acceptable) to locate the “Best sellers” section and choose a game that is listed there. Full credit if the agent clearly selects a game from the “Best sellers” area. Also award full credit if the agent makes reasonable attempts to find “Best sellers” but it is not accessible due to external factors (e.g., region/locale differences, A/B page layout changes, cookie/consent overlay issues, dynamic content not loading) and the agent clearly explains the blocker and then selects a game from the closest equivalent Xbox.com area (e.g., “Top paid,” “Most played,” “Trending,” or Microsoft Store charts). Partial credit if the agent selects from a different section without first attempting to find “Best sellers,” or if the alternative is weakly justified. No credit if the game is not from Xbox.com/Microsoft Store pages or is not reasonably tied to best-seller-style listings and no blocker is noted.

items.criterion: Open the selected game's product page
items.description: Open the product detail page for the chosen game on Xbox.com/Microsoft Store via Xbox.com. Full credit if the agent reaches the actual product detail page. Partial credit if the agent is prevented from opening the product page due to uncontrollable issues (e.g., CAPTCHA, hard login wall, persistent page error, age/region gating) and clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted (e.g., retry, alternate link, new tab). No credit if the agent stays on listing pages only or opens an unrelated/wrong game’s page when the correct one was accessible.

items.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
items.description: From the opened product page, accurately extract and report the game’s publisher, developer, and release date. Full credit if all three fields are correctly reported, including when the agent expands relevant sections (e.g., “Details,” “More,” “Show more”). Also award full credit if one or more of these fields are genuinely not shown on the product page (or are unavailable due to locale/region differences) after reasonable effort, as long as the agent clearly states which field(s) are missing/unavailable rather than fabricating values. Partial credit if only 1–2 fields are correctly reported while the missing fields were actually available on the page, or if fields are reported but with minor mismatch due to ambiguous labeling (e.g., studio vs. developer) and the agent cites what was visible. No credit if the values are fabricated, pulled from a different game/page, or asserted without any indication they came from the product page.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints (no sign-in; no buying/downloading; stop after recording details)
items.description: Agent does not sign in, does not initiate a purchase/checkout flow, and does not start a download; stops after opening the product page and recording publisher/developer/release date (or reporting unavailability). Full credit if constraints are respected throughout. Partial credit if the agent clicks into purchase-related UI (e.g., opens an edition selector or views pricing) but does not proceed to checkout/payment, does not sign in, and immediately backs out. No credit if the agent signs in, proceeds into checkout/payment steps, or initiates any download/install contrary to instructions.
